_comment: CW-VM-01 SAST pins, read by scripts/check-sast.ts. Bumping the image or the rules commit changes what is found: re-run `bun run sast:update`, give every NEW entry a reason, and say so in the PR. Never a tag or a branch; arch:sast refuses both.

excludeRules.reason: Not reproducible: a taint rule whose findings in the same file differed between a full scan, a scripts-only scan and a single-rule scan (4 vs 2 hits in scripts/claimmd-sandbox.ts), so it cannot be ratcheted. INFO severity, LOW confidence and impact (a forged console line); the hits were dev scripts plus two console.warn fallbacks in M36 services (ack-service, role-send-service) whose context is JSON.stringify-ed.

unscannedOk.reason: Generated OpenAPI client types, over Semgrep's 1 MB file limit even when named; it is regenerated by client:gen and contains no logic to analyse (arch:openapi-coverage and client:check guard it).

partialParse.reason: Semgrep's TypeScript parser lags the language, so it reads these files only in part and code in the unparsed region is not scanned. The scan fails on any file that is partly parsed and not listed here (new code could otherwise hide a sink in a region Semgrep skips) and on a listed file that now parses in full, so the list only shrinks. A listed file stays listed however much of it Semgrep reads, so a change to one needs a human read of the diff.
